data.name: Sunil Kulkarni
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sunil Kulkarni has made a big mark in cricket. With 65 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 70*, with an average of 15.31 and a quick strike rate of 137.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 26 sixes and 81 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 139.3 overs, taking 64 wickets at an economy rate of 8.65. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
